original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-sheaf-subset-stalks}
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a sheaf of sets on the topological space $X$.
For every open $U \subset X$ the map
$$
\mathcal{F}(U)
\longrightarrow
\prod\nolimits_{x \in U} \mathcal{F}_x
$$
is injective.
